learning_outcomes.text: Acquire the skills of independent elaboration and comprehension of design documents per hand and with application of computer.

syllabus_topics: Main characteristics and importance of the documentation of technical solutions
General requirements for the preparation of technical documents
Making drafts of items with electrical mounting, electrical schemes etc., rules for working out and reading
Symbols for expressing specific details from the electrical industry
Use of programming products for electrical drawings with application of computer
assessment_rules: The final mark is formed from the results of the course work and two control works.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS FEEA (datos antiguos; ver notas)
